name: To Sail the Sundered Tides
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield and [Arg2] Temporary Tentacles. Discard all cards in hand and draw the same number of cards.
lore:
The clouds will inform of the climate's changes, and the waves will speak of the ocean currents' transformations, but when the storm truly arrives, even the mightiest of ships can only helplessly drift with the waves.
At this moment, the navigator's calculations and guidance are the last refuge for all survivors.
Therefore, fulfill your duty, even if struck by lightning, to shine a glimmer of light through the pain, guiding the way to the shore.
That is the mission you must accomplish.
